subject: PAGE directive
notes: >> PAGE [ comment-text-1 ] - the operand is bracketed, so it is optional, and 7.3.19.3 SR2 states that comment-text-1 'is not checked syntactically'. The row's directiveOperand records that as form 'text' with the citation, so the absence of a content check is the standard's decision on the record rather than a gap. The directive is a no-op under 7.3.19.4 GR3 with no listing produced.
